offering_description.value: Provides in-home personal care, home health and hospice services to older adults, people with disabilities and patients recovering from illness or nearing the end of life.

primary_services.value: Personal care and assistance with daily activities; skilled home nursing; rehabilitation therapy; hospice and end-of-life care

items.detail: Older adults, people with disabilities, home health patients and hospice patients
Managed care organizations and private insurers arranging covered home care
State Medicaid agencies and other government programs purchasing home care services

end_markets.value: Home and community-based long-term care; senior and disability care; post-acute healthcare; hospice care

items.detail: Medicaid, Medicare and managed care payments for eligible personal care, home health and hospice services
Private payments for home care services
Organizes caregivers and clinical staff to deliver care in patients' homes, paid by public programs, insurers and individuals

geography_served.detail: Operates across multiple states and regions of the United States

company_size.value: Large multistate home care provider with an extensive branch network and related personal care, home health and hospice operations

specialization.detail: Personal care, skilled home health and hospice services serving overlapping home-based care needs

Patient referrals from healthcare providers, case managers and community organizations
